title: Natural condensation polymers
caption: Proteins are chains of amino acids joined by peptide (amide) links; polysaccharides such as starch are chains of glucose joined by glycosidic (C–O–C) links. Both form by condensation, releasing water, and are broken down by hydrolysis during digestion.
alt: A dipeptide with its peptide link shaded, and maltose, two glucose units joined by a glycosidic link.
description: Glycylalanine: two amino acids joined by –CO–NH–.
Maltose: two glucose rings joined by an oxygen bridge.
